item.name: transports

concerns.item: [Spec/Task discrepancy] Task lists create,get,list,revoke,redeem but spec defines create,redeem,pending_list,cancel,transports. No get or revoke per spec. Following spec - spec is authoritative. pending_list is the list method. cancel replaces revoke semantically for pending pairings. If get is intended, please add to spec.

[v1 limitation] Direct transport URL is hardcoded to None because server has no reliable way to determine public-facing direct URL. Spec example shows ws URL but this is documentation, not v1 contract. Client discovers URL from network config.
[v1 limitation] No scope check beyond principal presence. Spec mentions pairing:create for some methods but auth::check_server_policy only checks principal presence in v1.
[v1 limitation] redeem does NOT require principal per spec 'Server policy' without specific scope. Other write methods (create, cancel, pending_list) DO require principal.
[v1 limitation] No persistence: PairingStore is in-memory only. Restart loses all pairings. Acceptable for v1.
[v1 limitation] No notifications per spec line 872 '此域无需要 resync 的 notification'. No *changed events emitted.
Brute-force: wrong secret increments attempts on recent pending pairing. After 5 failed attempts, pairing removed, returns not_found. Empty store also returns not_found to avoid leaking information.
Self-redeem does not apply to pairing (no concept of self - client invokes redeem, not server). Different from client-auth self-revoke.
clientInfo validated non-empty after trim. No length bounds in v1. Length limits may be added later.
clientToken format ct-{uuid} matches client-auth clientId format for interoperability. v1 does NOT auto-create ClientAuthRecord on redeem; integration out of scope.
Transport validation: only direct or relay. Lowercase serialization via rename_all=lowercase.
create omits relay transport when not on relay connection (relayId unavailable).
transports returns BOTH direct and relay always, with available boolean.
Pagination: opaque cursor hex-encoded JSON via PaginatedResult::from_slice. limit 20 default, 100 max, 0 returns -32602.
Secret hash SHA-256 hex 64 chars. Plaintext never persisted.
All Mutex locks use .expect('pairing store mutex poisoned') for clear panic messages.

result.framework_notes: Integration: (1) ExtensionHandler trait via async_trait. Method dispatch match on sub_method string. Unknown returns ExtensionError::method_not_found() (code -32601). (2) create, pending_list, cancel call auth::check_server_policy(ctx, pairing, method) returning -32002 when principal empty. redeem does NOT call auth per spec. (3) pending_list uses pagination::PaginationParams. limit clamped via limit_or_default(20, 100). limit=0 explicit check. (4) All 5 methods use ensure_object_params helper returning -32602 if not JSON object. (5) Pagination: sort by created_at ASC, then PaginatedResult::from_slice. (6) All Mutex locks use .expect(pairing store mutex poisoned). (7) Token formats: pairingId = pair- + uuid. secret = pair-secret- + uuid1.simple() + - + uuid2.simple(). clientToken = ct- + uuid. (8) Secret hash SHA-256 hex stored as secret_hash. Plaintext never persisted. (9) is_expired helper: parse_from_rfc3339, fail=non-expired defensive. (10) is_relay_connection(ctx) = ctx.connection_id.starts_with(relay-). (11) chrono::Utc::now() captured once per create. (12) No notifications per spec line 872. (13) Brute-force: store.try_redeem increments attempts. After 5 failed, pairing removed. (14) Self-redeem does not apply. (15) Pairing/client-auth integration OUT OF SCOPE for v1. (16) Transport type via rename_all=lowercase. type field via rename=type. url and relay_id skip_serializing_if Option::is_none.
